findings.title: Decode attention computes over max_model_len KV slots
findings.summary: RPA decode kernels whose KV compute chunk far exceeds the live context are 68.1% of the decode step (attention 69.9%). The stock v7 decode block sizes set the KV block and compute chunk to max_model_len, so each step computes over every slot regardless of sequence length, and sliding-window layers c

evidence.detail: compute chunk 10240 >= max_model_len 10240; compute chunk 10240 is 10.0x the sliding window 1024; compute chunk 10240 is 5.0x the longest context 2048

findings.validation: A/B against a same-session control with separate compile cache roots (the vLLM compile cache key ignores env vars). Re-profile: decode kernels should read e.g. `bkv_1536_1536-sw_1024` / `bkv_10240_2560`. Gemma-3 27B TP8 v7x: decode step 21.93 -> 11.85 ms, +23-75% throughput.
findings.kernel_followup: Generic fix: per-layer RPA decode block sizes (sliding layers bkv = bkv_c ~ 1.5x window; global layers smaller compute chunks that divide the block), via the RPA block-size knobs (vLLM-TPU `RPA_V3_DECODE_BLOCK_SIZES`) or upstreaming scripts/common/vllm_patches/rpa_decode_block_sizes.patch to vllm-torchtpu.
source_refs: Gemma-3-27B TP8 on tpu7x, A/B against a same-session control, 2026-10-14: +23-75% throughput

findings.title: XLA compilation inside the serving window
findings.summary: 125 compile events (8.3 ms) happen after serving started; each blocks the engine loop.
findings.validation: Warm up all buckets before profiling; confirm no runtime compiles with the recompilation check enabled.
